description: Quiz a student on human anatomy with pictures: each question shows one structure lit up on a 3D human body (a bone, muscle, nerve, vessel, brain part or organ) with four names to choose from. Give a topic in the student's words (a region, a system or a lab practical, such as 'upper limb muscles', 'cranial nerves', 'bones of the skull' or 'muscles lab practical'), or the names on the student's own lab list. Use it when a student asks to be quizzed or tested on anatomy or to practise for an anatomy lab practical. Not for physiology calculations, diseases or medical advice.

structures.description: A course's own list of structure names to be quizzed on, used instead of a topic.

topic.description: What to be quizzed on, in the student's words: a region, a body system, a structure group or a lab practical.

name: quiz_anatomy_structures
title: Anatomy picture quiz
